label: literary fiction
context: {pov} has been considering leaving {place}. {other} has noticed the distance between them, but they have not talked about what leaving would mean. Their everyday work carries the weight of that unspoken choice.

label: mystery
context: An anonymous note has arrived at {place}, referring to an earlier disappearance. {pov} and {other} have different recollections of that day. Neither the note's author nor its connection to the present problem has been established.

label: fantasy
context: In this region, places can remember promises spoken inside them. {place} has begun repeating a fragment of an old vow after dark. {pov} and {other} do not know whose promise it was or whether it concerns them.

label: science fiction
context: {place} is part of a settlement on an artificial island maintained by autonomous systems. A recent system update has changed the way public records are synchronized. {pov} and {other} have not established whether this affects the events described below.

label: romance
context: {pov} has received a letter from an old love who wants to meet again. {other} knows about the invitation but has not read the letter. A possible reunion complicates {pov}'s feelings about remaining at {place}; no decision has been made.

label: horror
context: For three nights, people near {place} have heard their own voices answering from empty rooms. {pov} heard it once and has told {other}, who has not witnessed it. No cause has been established, and nobody agrees on whether entering alone is safe.

label: historical fiction
context: The year is 1936. News reaches {place} through letters, newspapers, and radio broadcasts. A regional strike has delayed ordinary deliveries, and {pov} and {other} are working with the supplies already on hand.

label: comedy
context: A visiting committee has mistaken {pov} for the person in charge of {place}. {other} knows the mistake, but an elaborate welcome has already begun. Their attempt to get through the visit without embarrassing anyone keeps producing smaller misunderstandings.

label: adventure
context: A route beyond {place} is opening for the first time in years. {pov} and {other} have been invited to join an expedition, but preparations are incomplete. The present problem must be considered alongside the chance to leave; they have not departed.

label: thriller
context: Someone has warned {pov} that a stranger will arrive at {place} before morning asking for information. {other} has seen signs that someone has been watching the entrance. The warning's source and the stranger's intentions remain unknown.
